description.summary: privileged shell protocol for the Huginn compositor

protocol.description:
The contract between the Huginn compositor and the muninn desktop shell.
This protocol covers only what no standard protocol provides. Panels, the dock and the wallpaper are wlr-layer-shell surfaces; the lock screen is ext-session-lock-v1. Do not duplicate those here.
The compositor only binds this global for clients it considers privileged. An unprivileged client that binds it must be treated as a protocol error.
Stability: additive changes only. Add requests and events and bump the interface version; never change or remove an existing one. Keeping to that is what makes moving this file to its own repository a mechanical step.

interface.name: raven_shell_manager_v1

description.summary: entry point for the desktop shell

interface.description: Handed to the shell so it can observe compositor state it cannot see as an ordinary client, such as which workspace is active.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Objects created through this manager are unaffected and must be destroyed separately.

request.name: get_workspace_state
request.description: Create an object that reports workspace count and which one is active, so a panel can render workspace indicators.

interface.name: raven_workspace_state_v1
interface.description: On creation the compositor sends the current state, then an update whenever it changes.

request.name: activate
request.description: Out-of-range indices are ignored rather than clamped.

event.name: state
event.description: Sent once on creation and again on every change.

arg.name: active
arg.summary: zero-based index of the active workspace

arg.name: occupied
arg.summary: one uint32 per workspace: nonzero if it holds windows
